extracted.intended_audience: petitioners, regulated parties, public stakeholders, researchers, and practitioners tracking petitions to EPA's Office of Land and Emergency Management
extracted.subtask_description: A public listing of petitions for rulemaking and related administrative petitions submitted to EPA's Office of Land and Emergency Management (OLEM), showing basic metadata, statutory basis, descriptions, and links to petition documents and status annotations. Useful for petitioners, stakeholders, and anyone tracking rulemaking requests, variances, and reconsideration petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of postings (which petitions are included)
rubrics_metrics.description: This page makes available petitions for rulemaking received by the Office of Land and Emergency Management (formerly Office of Solid Waste and Emergency Response) on or after January 1, 2013. For the purposes of this page, the agency has posted incoming communications styled as 'petitions' for generally applicable, national rulemakings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Petitions provided as comments in a publicly available rulemaking docket are not reproduced here. Additional petitions will be added on an ongoing basis as they are received or identified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Displayed petition metadata fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Each posted petition entry includes at least the following visible fields: Date Received; Petitioners; Related Statutes; Description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries often include links to the petition documents (PDFs), attachments, and other supporting materials; some entries also include document accessibility contacts and phone numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory basis must be identified
rubrics_metrics.description: Each petition listing includes the related statute(s) under which the petitioner is making the request (e.g., Resource Conservation and Recovery Act, Clean Air Act Section 112(r)(7), TSCA, Clean Water Act, Oil Pollution Act, Administrative Procedure Act).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page uses the statutory citation as a key organizational element and to indicate the legal/regulatory authority the petition concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types/categories of petitions posted
rubrics_metrics.description: The page includes multiple petition categories such as: requests for rulemaking; petitions for determinations (e.g., non-waste/NHSM determinations); petitions for variances or determinations of equivalent treatment; petitions for reconsideration and stay of final rules; requests to amend or clarify CFR provisions; petitions to list wastes as hazardous under RCRA; and petitions requesting regulatory revisions (e.g., dispersant use, CCR rules).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples in the list illustrate the types (e.g., variances from Land Disposal Restrictions, petitions to add materials to categorical non-waste lists, requests to reconsider RMP rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Status annotations and outcome tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: The listing annotates petitions with subsequent developments where applicable (e.g., 'petitioner withdrew this petition', 'EPA issued guidance', 'EPA denied the TSCA Section 21 portion', 'EPA approved a treatment variance', 'EPA issued a final denial', 'EPA published a proposal to grant with conditions', 'EPA will accept comments on this proposal through [date]').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page shows links to denial/approval documents, Federal Register notices, proposed responses, and withdrawal notices so users can follow outcomes and comment periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presence on the page is informational, not a grant or denial
rubrics_metrics.description: The presence of a petition on this page does not indicate an EPA decision to grant or deny the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any regulatory action that follows as a result of a petition for rulemaking would still be shaped by typical outreach used by the agency to gather stakeholder input and remains subject to any applicable notice and comment requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing updates and 'last updated' disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The page states that additional petitions will be added on an ongoing basis as they are received or identified and provides a 'last updated' date (page-level update timestamp).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries themselves may include later annotations with dates (e.g., dates of denials, approvals, proposals, or comment deadlines). The page-level 'Last updated' provides users a reference for currency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document access practice (links, PDFs, attachments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions and related materials are provided as downloadable documents (PDFs), sometimes with attachments; entries contain direct 'Read the petition' links and file size/format metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some entries include redacted versions or large attachments; entries occasionally reference Federal Register publications and provide links to those notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and accessibility information
rubrics_metrics.description: The page provides contact pathways (e.g., 'Contact Us about Petitions') and, for some entries, specific document accessibility contacts with phone numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are directed to contact the listed persons for accessibility or to ask questions, provide feedback, or report problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Descriptive summary requirement / petition description practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listing includes a concise description summarizing the petition's request or subject matter (e.g., requests for more stringent transport regulations for diluted bitumen; requests to classify certain materials as non-waste; requests to list PFAS wastes as hazardous under RCRA; requests for reconsideration of a final rule).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Descriptions often state the specific regulatory amendments or actions sought and may mention associated CFR sections or regulatory programs (e.g., 40 CFR part 258, 40 CFR 241.4(a), LDR 40 CFR 268.40).
